verdict.rationale: Anthropic's docs explicitly claim Claude Code plans, writes code across multiple files from plain-language descriptions, and verifies it works (claude-code-docs-2, -15, -16). However, hands-on community reports describe significant reliability problems undermining this claim, including self-inflicted bugs from unsafe replace-all edits, a self-reported '100% failure rate' user, degrading output quality over time, and Claude being described as a better reviewer than implementer requiring multiple correction rounds.
